newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian home gas transit duty to reflect distance.
newsitem.headline: Russian home gas transit duty to reflect distance.

text.p: Russia will change the structure of its natural gas transport tariffs so that they better reflect the distance gas travels to consumers, a deputy economy minister said on Thursday.
Vyacheslav Morgunov said the government had approved a ministry plan to increase the differential between the highest and lowest tariffs by the end of 1997.
"If now it is 10 percent, then it should grow to 25 percent," he told a news conference.

Russian natural gas transit tariffs are calculated essentially independently of transit distances. Consumers thousands of miles (kilometers) from northern gas fields essentially pay the same amount consumers close by.

The government is trying to introduce market principles into the natural gas industry and has vowed to open access to gas pipelines owned by monopoly Gazprom to any producer, including to oil companies.
